title: A Star Among Us
narration: This ball of fire is ninety-nine point eight six% of our solar system. Planets, moons, asteroids—less than point one four% of all mass. You've never truly seen it; we'll show you what it does every second.
visual_goal: Sun rising over landscape, overlay of solar system showing dominance

title: The Furnace Within
narration: Every second, the sun fuses six hundred million tons of hydrogen into helium—like swallowing five hundred thousand Earths. Core temperature: fifteen million degrees. It's done this for four point six billion years, outlasting any flame. Fury doesn't stay locked inside.
visual_goal: Cross-section of sun's core with fusion particles radiating

title: The Journey Out
narration: Surface blazes at five thousand five hundred degrees; corona above burns at over a million. Like a campfire scorching a mile away—a mystery. Every eleven years, the magnetic field flips, hurling storms we watch for.
visual_goal: Solar prominences and corona, then magnetic field lines flipping

title: Our Messenger
narration: To predict storms, Parker Solar Probe (twenty eighteen) flew within six point one million kilometers of the Sun in two thousand twenty-four—closer than ever. It plunges through million-degree plasma; it shouldn't exist, but sends secrets. The sun that nurtures will consume us.
visual_goal: Parker probe approaching sun with glowing heat shield

title: The Long Goodbye
narration: It will shine five billion more years, swell into a red giant—swallowing Mercury, Venus, possibly Earth. Not fiction—a calendar. Each sunrise is both promise and countdown. We're here to see this one.
visual_goal: Sun to red giant to white dwarf, fading to calm dawn
